pages.text: Health 75, Armor 6, Knockback Resistance 0.6, Attack 7, Speed 0.3.$(br)Immune to drowning and fall damage; lightning and magic damage are reduced by 50%%.$(br)$(l)Melee$(): a two-handed combo equal to its attack. Blade slash: 14 (attack x 2).$(br)6, Attack 7, Speed 0.3.

$(l)Arrows$(): double base damage, pierce 5 units, heavy knockback, and every third arrow explodes on hit. Chain lightning from Thunder: 3.5-7 (attack x 0.5-1.0).$(br)Thunder Reforged (10-second cooldown): with a bow it leaps up, hovers, draws and fires three charged arrows, each dropping a lightning strike where it lands.

It also swims, so it does not sink like an iron golem.$(br)6, Attack 7, Speed 0.3.$(br)$(l)Lightning Empowerment$(): struck by real lightning it enters an empowered state with permanent Charged I, chain lightning on melee, and Spasm/Thunderbolt/Storm Halberd added to Thunder; it becomes immune to lightning and fire, and magic damage is cut by another 50%%.$(br)6, Attack 7, Speed 0.3.
Block (10-second cooldown): triggers on a single physical hit above 15 or five hits within 60 ticks; blocks for 4 seconds with 85%% physical damage reduction and -50%% movement speed.
